writes: one create-only advisory EvaluationRecord under the selected TaskContext
one bounded Automation RunRecord and worker result under ES/Automation/Runs/TaskContextEvaluation

forbiddenProjections: Automation Accepted or Completed -> TaskContext evaluation accepted
Automation Static or Runtime -> TaskContext Profile or scope
Automation governanceHash -> TaskContext decisionId, recordHash, or snapshot hash

observability.planning: planTask with exact taskId, commandId, Skill, and route
observability.execution: runTask with the approved plan hash
observability.status: getRun returns Automation status and the bound EvaluationRecord separately
mismatchSignals: worker or input schema hash drift

rollback.fastPath: Disable the AI Bridge or omit es.task-context.evaluate from the selected RoutePlan.
rollback.registration: Remove only the ESTaskContextEvaluationAutomation initializer registration and rebuild the Editor assembly.
rollback.data: Keep immutable EvaluationRecords and RunRecords; rollback never deletes or rewrites prior evidence.
